name: Patio umbrella, 9 ft with base
clearanceBasis: ASSUMPTION (not a code determination): front 0.3 m, sides 0.1 m, back 0.1 m around the cast base only; the canopy overhangs about 1.14 m each side overhead and must clear the 0.91 m (36 in, ADA 403.5.1) accessible route and any wall or sign (head clearance 2.03 m / 80 in, ADA 307.2).

provenance.origin: market umbrella class (2.74 m canopy on a 0.46 x 0.46 m cast base, 2.44 m high; footprint is the base, canopy overhangs about 1.14 m each side)
provenance.notes: Place through a patio table hole or beside it; the canopy overhang is not part of the footprint. Dimensions are a class estimate, not a measurement; replace with a spec sheet or tape measure before purchase.
